plugins.name: agency-hub
plugins.description: Install first — bootstraps a git-versioned instance workspace (config/, brand/, squads/) via setup. Marketplace management is v2 — designed, deferred.

plugins.name: brand-creative
plugins.description: Complete brand practice in one install — setup interview, brand-voice lifecycle, and brand-guide visual identity. Writes to the instance brand/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/brand/.

plugins.name: web-development
plugins.description: Complete web engineering practice in one install — setup interview, architecture, epic design, implementation, code review, QA, and platform operations. Six personas (Frontend Engineer through WebOps), one owned skill library. Reads brand-guide from resolved brand path; invokes delivery-practice for planning cadence.

plugins.name: delivery-practice
plugins.description: Complete delivery practice in one install — setup interview, product strategy, backlog and sprint cadence, validation, and operational skills. Two personas (Product Manager, Delivery Lead), one owned skill library.

plugins.name: content-marketing
plugins.description: Complete content practice in one install — setup interview, editorial calendar, social curation, media analysis, and CMS seed drafting. Two personas (Content Strategist, Content Writer), one owned skill library. Reads brand voice from resolved brand path; invokes delivery-practice for backlog and research.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: Minimal UX practice in one install — setup interview and wireframe skill for low-fidelity layout and interaction specs. Writes to the instance design/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/design/.

plugins.name: search-optimisation
plugins.description: Complete search and technical SEO practice in one install — setup interview, keyword research, technical audits, and content SEO review. One persona (SEO Specialist), one owned skill library. Invokes delivery-practice for competitive brief.
